generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender fees shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement (KPP) Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the PDO reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards must be ensured so that no untoward incidents happen on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders thereon.

The successful bidder must follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor must submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise, Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bengaluru dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it must be rectified on his own risk and cost.

Materials like bitumen, steel, and cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get evaluated by the Quality Assurance Authority before commencement of the work.
The Defect Liability period for this work is 1 years.
The bidder must establish field laboratory at the work site as per GO No: PWD/243/SEV/2013 Bengaluru dated:22.07.2014.
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per attached K/W 1 Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26- achieved in at least any Two financial year on average annual financial turnover in all classes of civil engineering construction works only of Rs 8.50 Lakhs-Submit consolidated Annual Turnover Certificate attested by CA with UDIN Number
Assessed available tender capacity - Bidder should upload the calculation copy with signature

The bidder must have satisfactorily completed at least one similar work as a Prime Contractor, equivalent to a minimum of 50 percentage of the estimated cost of the proposed work, during the last 5 years, supported by a completion certificate issued by the competent authority
